notes: IWE001 is the only currently extracted strict-H1 mutualist programme; its three site effects are dependent and count as one programme. IWE004 and IWE005 were source-adjudicated to timing/context lanes.

IWE035 remains source-coefficient/data unresolved. IWE067 adds a second strict bridge with a prospectively frozen raw-data reconstruction from 2017-2018 Ipomopsis flowering, Hylemya egg timing and final fruit fate; raw file streams are currently inaccessible in this environment. IWE032-IWE034 remain nonlinear/bidirectional shape evidence.

IWE064 is the first quantitatively closed strict mixed programme; IWE059 remains unresolved-strict. IWE066 is preregistered-H2 interior-peak shape evidence without a formal numerical curvature coefficient. IWE065 is a benefit-channel-only effect and remains outside net mixed H1.
